title: UK ETS aviation AOHA and surrender QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS Registry records allowance allocation, trading and surrender transactions.
Aviation emissions and surrender activity are managed through the Aircraft Operator Holding Account.
facts.expected_handling: Bind aviation registry status to AOHA.

facts.source_fact: Where an independent verifier is used, verified emissions are recorded in the AOHA after report submission to the regulator.
Simplified-reporting emissions are recorded between 1 April and 30 April after regulator review.
Allowances equal to aviation emissions must be surrendered by 30 April following the scheme year.
The surrender duty remains even if an aviation-emissions figure has not yet been recorded in the AOHA.
facts.expected_handling: Do not use missing registry figure as surrender exemption.

facts.source_fact: The surrender duty remains even if the operator believes the AOHA emissions figure is incorrect.
Operators must ensure authorised representatives have the permissions needed to surrender allowances.
Registry transfers can only start or complete on working days between 10am and 4pm UK time.
A 24-hour transaction delay applies when the destination is not on the supplier's trusted account list.
facts.expected_handling: Account for transfer delay in readiness checks.

guard_patterns.handling: Do not infer surrender exemption from missing/disputed AOHA values.
Do not invent allowance or emissions amounts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
